Hello fellow Voaters,

My question to you all is, as stated in the title, are we witnessing the death of the written word? Increasingly in our digital age, it has become more and more frustratingly difficult to find valuable information on popular discussion topics that aren't confined to the video sphere; this isn't to say that the content is of any lesser quality than what you'd see in a published paper or even a simple blog post, but rather that it's increasingly difficult to find that same kind of information simply...written down somewhere.

Take, for example, the all-too-familiar scenario of browsing your favorite news website, you see an interesting article headline, and are directed to a page with a couple of advertisements and an embedded YouTube clip of a segment that aired the previous day, or earlier that morning. You close it out, and think how nice it would have been to have had something you could have read a little bit of, then come back to finish in pieces as time allows.

Or another scenario, you've been playing Cool New Video Game, and rumblings around your circles are that the first major content patch is just around the corner. Excited, you log on to the developer's website, and eventually find an announcement that the details of the content patch will be revealed...in a live stream. No list on the official forums, nothing of the sort. Just a livestream. Hours later, someone with nothing better to do will condense the content of the live stream down into a bullet-pointed text post, but you still feel cheated, because the developers couldn't be bothered to simply list out the major points.

Often times, I find myself unable to stay up to date on the things I care about - take, for example, the Gamergate controversy. I'd love to know what all the goings on day-to-day are, but I just can't sit there and stare at Sargon or whomever you'd like prattle on for 45 minutes. I could read the same information in a blog post, in a tenth of the time.

Am I on an island here, lamenting the death of the written word? Am I just being overly dramatic?

What's your thoughts, voaters?
